Compare the certificate and photography course. Ask about duration and whether a qualification is awarded. Choose the option suited to an evening-study role and explain your choice.

Meet a classmate. Introduce yourself, discuss one enjoyable or challenging part of study, and accept or decline coffee.
Your assignments are taking too long. Explain the difficulty and ask about study support. Add a financial-help or housing question if you want another branch.

“The certificate meets on Tuesday evenings, so it fits my schedule. What qualification does it award?” / “How can I contact admissions?” / “I like the projects, but there's a lot to learn. I'd like coffee. What time?” / “I'm having trouble finishing the assignments. Who can I talk to about study support?”
Return later with another study goal. Check that you could compare options, ask for missing facts and seek the appropriate help without assuming every college follows the practice conditions.
